headline_marked: 4 killed in Rangpur: [[Retired teacher and family of 4 killed]] in suspected robbery
headline: 4 killed in Rangpur: Retired teacher and family of 4 killed in suspected robbery
summary: The victims include a retired teacher from Rangpur Zilla School, his wife, and their two children. Police and CID are investigating the motive.
details: The bodies of retired Rangpur Zilla School teacher Ganapati Chakraborty, his wife, and their two children were recovered from their three-story building in Kamal Kachna Machhuapara village, Rangpur city.
Local residents and police discovered the bodies on Saturday night around 8:30 PM after the house was found locked from the outside.
According to the CID, the victims were strangled to death with ropes or towels 3-4 days ago.
Investigators found the building's electricity connection had been cut off and the place where money was kept had been broken into, suggesting a robbery occurred.
Police are currently investigating the lead to identify and arrest the killers.
caption:
A retired teacher, his wife, and their two children were found dead in their home in Rangpur.

The bodies of retired Rangpur Zilla School teacher Ganapati Chakraborty, his wife, and their two children were recovered from their three-story building in Kamal Kachna Machhuapara village, Rangpur city.

Local residents and police discovered the bodies on Saturday night around 8:30 PM after the house was found locked from the outside.

According to the CID, the victims were strangled to death with ropes or towels 3-4 days ago.

Investigators found the building's electricity connection had been cut off and the place where money was kept had been broken into, suggesting a robbery occurred.

Police are currently investigating the lead to identify and arrest the killers.

Source: Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV

headline_marked: Fire breaks out at [[Royal Aid Hospital in Khilgaon]], no casualties reported
headline: Fire breaks out at Royal Aid Hospital in Khilgaon, no casualties reported
summary: Two fire service units controlled the blaze, which reportedly started in the generator room. All admitted patients were immediately evacuated.
details: A fire broke out at Royal Aid Hospital, a private healthcare facility in the capital's Khilgaon area, on Saturday night.
The Fire Service and Civil Defence received the report around 11:00 PM on August 22. Two units were quickly deployed to the scene to bring the blaze under control.
Ariful Islam, Senior Station In-charge of the Khilgaon Fire Service, confirmed that there were no casualties in the incident.
According to officials, the fire originated in the hospital's generator room. All patients admitted to the hospital were evacuated immediately to ensure their safety.
Authorities are currently investigating whether there were any shortcomings or negligence on the part of the hospital management regarding safety protocols.
caption:
A late-night fire hit a private hospital in Khilgaon. Patients were rushed out as flames broke out in the generator room.

A fire broke out at Royal Aid Hospital, a private healthcare facility in the capital's Khilgaon area, on Saturday night.

The Fire Service and Civil Defence received the report around 11:00 PM on August 22. Two units were quickly deployed to the scene to bring the blaze under control.

Ariful Islam, Senior Station In-charge of the Khilgaon Fire Service, confirmed that there were no casualties in the incident.

According to officials, the fire originated in the hospital's generator room. All patients admitted to the hospital were evacuated immediately to ensure their safety.

Authorities are currently investigating whether there were any shortcomings or negligence on the part of the hospital management regarding safety protocols.

#Bangladesh #Dhaka #FireIncident #Khilgaon #EmergencyNews

Source: Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo
